description: This file defines constants and functions related to file paths for bundled plugins, including directory paths, file path generation functions, and specific test glob patterns.

methods.name: bundledPluginRoot
methods.description: Returns the root directory path for a plugin based on its ID.

methods.name: bundledPluginFile
methods.description: Constructs the full path to a plugin file given its ID and relative path.

methods.name: bundledDistPluginRoot
methods.description: Returns the distribution directory path for a plugin based on its ID.

methods.name: bundledDistPluginFile
methods.description: Constructs the full path to a distribution plugin file given its ID and relative path.

methods.name: bundledPluginCallsite
methods.description: Returns a string representing a callsite with file path and line number.
